proposals.evidence: DEDR827 gives Kannada ede/edde chest/breast/courage and Tulu ede heart/chest, with Telugu eda heart. Kudiya ede, Badaga etə and Betta Kurumba yaddi are proposed comparative heart/chest-family variants, preserving initial glide, dental voicing and source sense. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
